text: {"final": {"summary": "Created scripts/merge_duplicates.py (P1): it loads all households via registry.register.load_households(), groups duplicates with registry.dedup.find_duplicates, and for each group keeps the first household whose ID passes core.ids.is_valid_household_id, marking every other member merged via registry.register.set_status(hid, \"merged\", merged_into=kept_id). No records are deleted and non-duplicate households are untouched; each group is printed for the run log. Ran it once (P2): 6 duplicate groups were merged — kept HH-16098, HH-16152, HH-16500, HH-16705, HH-16845, HH-16888 (all valid IDs), with HH-15817, HH-16220, HH-16358, HH-16723, HH-16746, HH-17090 respectively marked merged into them (all invalid IDs, confirming the mistyped-ID duplicates were the ones merged).", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2"]}}
